_note: Who can't be bought at the next IPL auction, with evidence a reviewer can check. Keyed by cricsheet_id. Fields: _name; status = "retired" (announced retirement: never in an auction pool again) or "not_registered" (did not enter the auction of the listed `seasons` only: kept in later pools, recorded so a reviewer sees why a veteran is still there) or "unconfirmed" (may not be allowed to play the listed `seasons`, no ruling yet: kept in the pool and flagged with `note`) or "banned" (barred from the tournament and the player auction of the listed `seasons`: IPL Player Regulations 2025-27 item 6, a player who is bought and then makes himself unavailable before the season is banned for 2 seasons; out of the pool and off his squad for those seasons); scope = "ipl" (out of the IPL and Indian cricket, may still play other leagues) or "all" (all cricket); date = the announcement (YYYY-MM-DD); role_now = a coaching or staff role, if any; _evidence = [{title, url, date}]. Read by scripts/export_site.py (the auction pool, METHODOLOGY section 7) and by the player master (`retired` / `retired_scope`, src/cricdex/scout/identity/master.py). Retirements found in a Wikipedia 'List of <season> Indian Premier League personnel changes' page belong here; the master build lists any it can't find (player_master_review.json `todo`).
